tei:div.tei:p: karma pa sku phreng drug pa

rje mthong ba don ldan gyi lo rgyus/ ༄༅/ /na rim drug pa rje mthong ba don ldan ni/ sngon chos kyi rjes mdo khams karma'i nye logs su 'dun pa gtad zin gsungs pa dang khams kyi spyan 'dren pa rnams la mdo khams nyid du myur du 'phrad par bya'o/ /zhes pa bka' stsal pa ltar karma dang nye ba ngom stod bshes skyam zhes pa'i sa'i char/ yab go 'jo bsam grub rdo rje dang yum sdong bza' pad+ma mtsho gnyis kyi sras su spre lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la sku 'khrungs/ tsog pur bzhugs te yum la gzigs shing bzhad/ dri bzang gis yul thams cad khyab/ yab kyi rmang lam du skye shing zhig btsug pa dpag bsam gyi shing du gyur nas lo 'dab kyis 'jig rten khyab pa dang*/ yum gyi rmang lam du phrag gong du nyi zlas brgyan pa/ nyi zla gnyis khong du zhugs pa/ dung dkar g.yas 'khyil chen po zhig bus pas khams gsum du grags pa sogs rmis pa rnams byis par zhus pas rmi lam gyi brda bkrol rnams rgyas par gsungs ngom pa bya bral ba la yang sprul ba'i sku 'khrungs pa'i ltas byung*/ sku bltams nas zla ba gcig dang zhag bzhi song bar yab yum rnams rnam rgyal sgang du slong mor byon pas ngom pa bya bral ba gzigs ma thag mnyes pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma mdzad nas ā li kā li gsungs/ khong gi byis pa de dben par khrid nas khyod su yin smros zhes dris pas/ bya bral ba'i mdzub mor bzung nas/ nga ni skye med brjod pa kun dang bral// gnas med gnas bral 'khor ba'i 'gro ba rnams// ma lus thar pa'i gnas su 'dren pa'i phyir// skye 'gro kun gyi dpal du bdag 'gyur to// na ma tshar bar yul gzhan mi spo 'dug/ ces pa'i tshig 'di re zhig gsang gsungs pas sprul pa'i sku yin par thag chod de zhabs tog mdzad/ zla ba bdun bzhes pa na khri thog tu bzhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi mtshan mang po gsungs/ yig drug gi sgom lung mdzad/

nya khang du spyan drangs pas rten rnams la gzigs/ khyad par zhwa nag can la gzigs zhing bzhad pas de su lags zhus pas thugs kar phyag mdzub btsugs nas nga yin zhes bskyor nas gsungs/ bla ma gcod dig pa la dag snang mang du shar bas dad pa thob ste thams cad la sprul pa'i sku byon par bsgrags/ karma nas gnyer pa ja 'dren la 'ong ba'i ming nas bos/ karmar phebs dus phyag nas 'thor bas 'brum yams chad/ mar me'i sdong bu'i rtser spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho zhal gzigs/ thang sku zhig la phyag nas gnang bas nas 'bru bdun chags/ sngon gnas rjes dran dang ma 'ongs lung bstan du ma gsungs pas thams cad yid ches/ drung pas thog mar mjal dus ngas phyag mdud byin pa de yod dam gsungs/ de blangs nas phul bas har gyis bzhengs te sku la tshad pa na sku bongs dang mnyam tshad pa byung bas sngon gyi lung bstan du dgongs nas spyan chab mang du bsil shing zhabs la gtugs/ slar rnam rgyal sgang du phebs/ khros nag dang*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ ma mgon gnyis gnas brtan bcu drug rnams zhal gzigs/ rten rnams la rab gnas mdzad skabs nas 'bru rnams nam mkhar chags pa dang*/ rten la zug pa sogs byung*/ than pa chen po byung dus chu rtsed kyi rnam pa dang bden stobs brjod pa'i mod la char chen babs/ de nas karmar phebs/ mkhas grub chen po 'jam dbyangs grags pa dpon slob rnams phebs/ 'bul zhabs chen po phul/ mkhan chen mgo blon pa la thugs rje chen pos lung bstan byung nas sgar pa rnams la dar chen kha re bkyes/ nga yi bla ma khams na yab yum 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba sku 'khrungs yod 'dra bas/ nga'i bla ma thugs chad kyi dogs gsungs shing dbus nas khams su sprul pa'i sku mjal bar pheb pas/ sprul ba'i skus kyang nged kyi phyi gzhis yong gi yod ces gsungs/ karma'i yang dgon du mjal/ chang ja'i gral du karma kun spangs pas khyed rang gis thugs la btags pa zhig la gsol ras gnang ba zhu zhus pas/

ston pa gsung nas gnang bas kun yid ches par gyur/ yum 'da' ba na dga' ldan du phrad do gsungs/ lha steng du zla ba gzas bzung pa na rgya nag rgyal po'i zhal ras 'dra gsungs shing de'i tshul rgyas par gsungs/ go 'jo bdag pos zhwa nag la bltas pa na/ 'di rgya zhwa min hor dus kyi yin sogs sngon ma thos pa du ma gsungs/ dgung lo gsum ma rdzogs pa tsam yin yang skya ser khri phrag mang por chos 'brel thog med du gsungs bas/ khrom thams cad kyis 'tshams par thos/ gzhan la ku re dang co 'dri'i rnam pas chos kyi tshigs bcad thogs med du gsungs shing sus kyang lan ldon par mi spobs/ dga' ldan sogs dag zhing gi bkod pa mtha' yas pa gsungs/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa la/ ni gu ma'i chos skor/ shang chos rgyud sde lnga sogs/ zhi byed sogs dang*/ mdo mang gi lung sogs gsan nas mkhas par gyur pa'i tshul bstan/ rab 'byams phyogs bcu ma'i bstod pa mdzad pas thams cad ngo mtshar/ sog dbon bka' bzhi pa las phag mo'i dbang gsan skabs rdul tshon dkyil 'khor steng nas rnal 'byor ma lha lnga zhal gzigs pa sogs dag pa rab 'byams su gzigs snang mtha' yas shing*/ de ltar dbang sgrub thabs lung bshad pa sogs mtha' dag gsan te/ de yang mi g.yo ba dkar po/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lnga dgu /tshe dpag lha dgu /rnam 'joms dkar po/ /sgra mi snyan gyi tshe gzungs/ thugs dam lnga tshan lnga/ rnam 'joms ba ri lugs/ tshe dpag grub rgyal ma/ bde mchog lū yi pa/ nag po pa/ dril bu pa/ me tri bcu gsum ma/ dgyes rdor rngog lugs/ rta mgrin thugs dril/ gdugs dkar bi ma'i luḍa/ phyag rdor gtum po'i rjes gnang*/ ma mgon 'khor lnga'i rjes gnang*/ rdor phreng bla med ltar gyi dkyil 'khor nyer brgyad/ sgrub thabs brgya rgyam gyi rjes gnang*/ rdzogs chen gsang skor/ mkha' 'gro snying thig /bi ma snying thig /srung ba lnga'i rig gtad dang*/

gdong drug gi dbang*/ rang byung rdo rje'i bka' 'bum tshang ma/ ba mkhal ma'i gzhung*/ rol pa'i rdo rje'i bka' 'bum/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' 'bum rnams kyi lung dang*/ nā ro chos drug /phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor/ sku gsum ngo sprod/ jo nang*/ tsa mi/ bu ston rnams kyi sbyor drug / o rgyan bsnyen sgrub/ mar pa'i shog dril/ gtum mo 'khor lo lnga khrid rnams dang*/ gcod dbang nam mkha' sgo 'byed dang gcod khrid/ do ha skor gsum/ bslab btus/ 'dul ba me tog phreng brgyud/ bde mchog bstod 'grel/ byams chos lnga/ rigs pa'i tshogs/ lag pa'i tshad/ rmi lam yid bzhin nor bu/ nang don rang 'grel bcas/ spyod 'jug /thogs med bka' 'bum rnams kyi lung rnams gsan/ bsod nams bzang po las byang sa'i sems bskyed dang*/ dus 'khor dang*/ 'dus pa gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi dbang dang tshe dpag grub rgyal ma'i rjes gnang rnams gsan/ zhwa dmar chos dpal ye shes drung nas/ dwags po bka' 'bum/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho skor gsum/ mgon po skor gsum dang sgrub skor/ ma mo skor gsum rnams kyi lung dang*/ zhal sbyor gyi dbang bzhi dang lha mo'i rjes gnang*/ karma pak+shi'i bka' 'bum las phal cher dang*/ chos drug sras mkhar ma/ phyag chen gaṅgā ma sogs dang*/ ka kha'i do ha/ gcod skor/ shrī sidha'i dmar khrid/ o rgyan pa dang*/ ras chen pa dang*/ dus mkhyen rnam thar/ dpag bsam 'khri shing*/ dpa' bo'i skyes rabs so bzhi pa/ jo bo'i chos chung brgya rtsa/ phag mo drung mdzad ma/ mkha' spyod bka' 'bum rnams kyi lung dang*/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga dang*/ 'dus pa 'phags lugs 'gos dang mar pa nas brgyud pa/ spyan ras gzigs pad+ma rgyal po/ dril bu lus dkyil phag mo zhal bzhi ma/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dbang*/ rdzogs chen rgyud bcu bdun gyi lung rnams zhus/ zla ba dpal rin po che las/

rtse mo rigs bsdus kyi dbang dang*/ dpal mchog rigs bsdus/ khams gsum rnam rgyal/ gtsug dgu/ 'chi 'joms/ rdor dbyings/ don yod zhags pa/ rnam snang mngon byang*/ srung ba lnga'i rig gtad/ bde mchog sdom 'byung*/ sgyu thod gdan gsum/ dril chung lha lnga/ rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po/ spyan ras gzigs pad+ma drwa ba/ sgrol ma lus dkyil/ 'dus pa zhabs lugs/ 'dus pa spyan ras gzigs/ phyag rdor 'khor chen/ gdong drug rnams kyi dbang dang sgron gsal gyi lung rnams gsan/ de dus karmar dge lugs kyi sngags chog mang du btsugs nas sgrub mchod byed pa'i gral dbur pheb pa na drung rin po che nas 'di 'dra dgos don ci gsungs bar nged rang gi yig cha mi 'dug pas yin zhus pas yig cha ngas brtsam pas chog gsungs nas rdo rje dbyings kyi sgrub dkyil sdom pa lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs sogs bka' 'bum na bzhugs pa rnams brtsams par mdzad/ mgon po'i rnga 'chams dang dbyangs sogs lhag pa'i lhas gnang bzhin gsar du mdzad/ de nas zur mang rtsi rgyud/ rong po bar thang sogs su phebs/ de phyogs kyi mi dang mi min thams cad btul/ de nas lha dang mkha' 'gros lung bstan te tsā rir phebs/ de yang*/ karma/ ngom rnam rgyal sgang*/ sha rong khang sar dgon/ po to dgon/ bla dgon/ dpal 'bar la sogs chos sde rnams su chos gsungs pa'i tshe me tog gi char babs/ de nas nyang lung brgyud kong por phebs/ rnam thos kyi ri bor bdag 'jug gi tshe/ tshe dpag med zhal gzigs/ gtor chog gi skabs rgyal chen bzhi yang gzigs/ ser ba dang rlung nag sogs la sdig mdzub gtad pas zhi/ zhwa dmar chos dpal ye shes las gtso bor yi dam chos skyong gi skor sogs gsan/ dgung lo dgu pa 'brug lor 'ol kha bkra shis thang du mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po/ /bka' bzhi pa rat+na bha dra/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/

dad pa'i dge 'dun bcas pa'i dbus su rab tu byung*/ chos grags dpal bzang por mtshan gsol/ mkhan bsod nams bzang po'i drung nas/ dus 'khor gsung dbang*/ gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi dbang dang sems bskyed sogs zhus slad nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan po yang zhus pas zhal bzhes gnang mod/ phyis dgung lo tshigs tshang du nye bar gser yig pa zhig gi nye gnas kyis sprul pa'i sku bsnyen rdzogs bsgrub zin zhes rdzun zhus pas zhal ngo nag ting gis song ste zhag gsum nas sku gshegs par snang*/ dwags la sgam por phebs/ tsā ri'i rgya mtsho sgang du phebs pa'i tshe/ mgon po lcam dral zhal gzigs/ dge 'dun rnams la thub pa'i skyes rabs dang*/ phyag chen chos drug sogs kyi chos 'khor bskor/ tsā ri'i gnas skor la phebs/ rdo rje phag mo'i gling*/ lha mo'i pho brang*/ thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum/ slob dpon pad+ma byams pa chos 'khor sogs gnas gsar rnams phyes/ rdo rje phag mo zhal gzigs bstod pa mdzad/ bkra shis ljongs su dgra bcom pa dri med 'od zer gyis lung bstan nas tshe dpag med kyi mngon rtogs brtsam/ rgya mtsho sgang du chos kyi blo gros btsun mor bcas pa dang*/ bde mchog dang*/ 'jam dbyangs zhal gzigs nas bstod pa mdzad/ sgrol ma dang*/ dwags po rin po che dang*/ thub pa zhal gzigs bstod pa mdzad/ gnas lung du phag mos lung bstan cing gdams ngag gnang*/ 'phrag yul du pad+ma mkha' 'gros rjes su bzung*/ rgyal 'dzing du gu ru lha dar gyi khang pa la gtsang po ches nye ba phyag nas mdzad pas bzlog par mdzad/ rgya lar nag po chen po dang*/ ye gang du/ sgrol dkar dang*/ gnas sgo 'ding po cher slob dpon pad+ma dang*/ mar khu thang du/ rta mgrin nag po/ sgrol dkar/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ 'od dpag med rnams dang*/ bzang snar rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lnga/ kong por stag khrom du ba dan gyi rtser mkha' 'gro sde lnga/

tai lo pa/ bi ma la/ mi la ras pa gtso 'khor gsum/ ḍom+bi pa stag la chibs pa btsun mor bcas/ sa ra ha gtso 'khor gsum/ dam pa sangs rgyas/ tshem bu pa/ birba pa btsun mor bcas pa/ ras chen pa dang spom brag pa/ rdo rje 'chang dang*/ dus mkhyen g.yung ston la rma bya du mas mchod pa rnams zhal gzigs/ sngon gyi spyod tshul du ma thugs la shar te/ de dag gi rgyu mtshan drung rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar 'di skad/ sngon byung bskal pa 'di nyid la/ / zhes sogs yul 'khor skyong dang*/ drang srong dga' 'byed/ drang srong dka' thub can dang*/ yang 'das pa'i skyes rabs rgya mtsho sogs mang po gsungs/ seṅge rdzong du sgrol ma gtso 'khor gsum/ bad phug tu slob dpon pad+ma dang rdo rje shugs/ dpang phug tu sa ra ha/ slob dpon pad+ma/ dam pa sangs rgyas rnams zhal gzigs pa sogs dang*/ rdo rje phag mos pad+ma rā ga'i bum pas dbang bskur ba dang*/ mthing mtshor ber nag can la chos skyong mang pos bskor ba dang*/ dung mtshor dpal lha mo la ma mo du mas bskor ba dang*/ phrin las mtsho bzhir ḍā ki rigs bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gting zab phug tu bde mchog la dpa' bo nyer bzhis bskor ba dang*/ phag mo dbu bcad ma/ bde mchog 'jam rdor/ 'dus pa 'jam rdor/ nag po chen po/ mai tri mkha' spyod/ bde mchog dkar po/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha lnga/ mkha' spyod dmar mo/ shes rab gsal byed/ rdo rje gzhon nu rdor sems yab yum/ dus 'khor/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ seṅge sgra/ rdo rje phag mo phag gdong chen mo/ dbang du byed pa'i sgrol ma/ mchod rten sgo mang dang*/ khrus rdzing phug tu rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams zhal gzigs/ mngon dgar rdo rje mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs nas gdams pa gnang*/ o rgyan pa dang*/ mkha' spyod pa gzigs/ dbus kyis cha 'brang rgyas thang du/ gong ma'i gdan 'dren gser yig pa stong phrag bzhi tsam gyis mjal/

gser dngul gos dar sogs 'bul ba rgya chen phul de dag chos dang zang zing gis tshims par mdzad/ nags phur sgrol ma lha lnga zhal gzigs/ sog pa mdor sde 'khrug chen po bsdum/ snye bor phebs/ sgrol dkar zhal gzigs mkha' 'gro ma mang pos gar byed pa'ang gzigs/ gsa' phur phebs/ bde mchog rigs brgyad gzigs/ rgya mtsho sgang du 'jam dbyangs dkar po dang*/ phag mo/ nā ro pa gtso 'khor gsum rnams zhal gzigs/ gzhan yang rnam thar nor bu rab brtsegs dang*/ yon tan rin chen mi zad gter dang*/ rgyas pa'i mtsho skyes rnams las 'di rigs shin tu rgyas par gsungs so// nyang po kho mdar phebs/ klu sgrub yab sras dang*/ phag mo dbu bcad ma zhal gzigs/ re rgyab tu phebs/ rta mgrin zhal gzigs/ mtshur phur dpal mgon po dngul gyi me long 'dzin pa dang lha mo gdugs dkar zhal gzigs/ lha sa jo bo'i drung du kun mkhyen rong po sogs skya ser khri phrag mang por zab rgyas kyi chos 'khor bskor/ kun mkhyen rong ston shin tu dad de rang gi gzigs snang dang mthun par/ steng na lha yi gdugs dkar legs bzung zhing sogs bstod pa mdzad/ sprul pa'i skus kyang tshur la gzhung lugs dang man ngag du ma gsan pas nga la sangs rgyas slob mar yod pa yin zhes seṅge'i sgra chen po bsgrags par mdzad/ sna 'bar du ḍom+bi he ru ka zhal gzigs/ yang mtshur phur nag po chen po dang dbyangs can ma zhal gzigs nas bstod pa mdzad/ dus 'khor dang*/ mgon po 'brug la chibs pas gtor ma gsol ba dang*/ ral gri bsnams pa gzigs/

gnam mtsho dang na mar sogs su phebs/ rong po dang mi nyag gi 'khrug pa bsdum/ stag lung du 'dus sder chos gsungs pa'i tshe me tog gi char babs/ rngod du phebs/ dam can dang zhing skyong gis phrin las bsgrub par khas blangs/ so rir phag mo don grub ma zhal gzigs/ rnam thos kyi ri bor kha dog sna tshogs pa'i nam mkha' lding dang zho khar 'jam dpal tshe bdag zhal gzigs/ snye bor phebs/ tshe dpag med dkar po dang*/ sprin sa lar mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dpa' gcig dang g.yu mtshor gdugs dkar dang rnal 'byor nam mkha' dbu thog tu rin po che'i gdugs yod pa dang rdo rje rnam 'joms dkar po la lha mo bcu drug ting ting shag brdung bas bskor ba gzigs/ lho rong du phebs nas de phyogs kyi gdul bya rnams chos dang*/ zang zing gis tshims par mdzad/ bstan bcos 'gyur ro tshal gos dar gyis na bza'i thum bcas bzhengs/ ngom sgang rnam rgyal sgang du phag mo ser mo rgyan spangs pa gzigs/ karma dgon du phebs/ skya ser mang por chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ zur mang dgon du 'khor lo bde mchog zhal gzigs/ sgrol ma lha khang du sgrol ma ljang gu zhal gzigs nas bstod pa mdzad/ der mi la ras pa zhal gzigs nas bstod pa'ang mdzad/ slar karmar phebs/ rang byung rgyal mo dang*/ rdo rje gtum po zhal gzigs nas bstod pa mdzad/ 'brong dur rje nyid 'khor lo bde mchog nam mkha' khengs par sprul nas 'gro ba 'dul ba'i sgyu 'phrul mtha' yas pa bstan/ phyag rdor gyi spyi bor sa chen kun snying bzhugs pa gzigs/ shar phyogs spungs rir 'jig rten dbang phyug dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba gzigs/ der rta mchog thugs dril zhal gzigs nas sgrub thabs mdzad/ 'di bde chen gling pa'i rta phyag khyung gsum gyi sgrub thabs dang gcig par 'dug kaṃ po gnas nang du phebs/ chos 'khor rgya cher bskor/ mkha' 'gro gling du phag mo ser mo phyag mtha' yas pa dang chos khri thang du mgon po dar sna tshogs kyi ba dan bsnams pa zhal gzigs/

spang phug tu sa ra ha rig ma gnyis dang bcas pa zhal gzigs/ der lwa ba pa zhal gzigs/ li thang du pheb tshe rab sgang gi gzhi bdag rnams kyis bsu ba gzigs/ 'gom sgang du bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar mo can zhal gzigs/ dza lan+dha rar phebs/ mkhas grub 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i bu chen rnams kyis gser dngul sogs 'bul chen bstabs/ phyag drug pa zhal gzigs/ k+ṣe tra pā las kho bo 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i bka' srung yin pas gtor ma byin cig zhus pas de phyin chad gtor ma 'bul bar mdzad/ nag po chen po rin po che'i rgyan can dang rje phag mo gru pa zhal gzigs/ khyed kyi phrin las kyi grogs la byon pa yin gsungs/ de phyogs kyi bshes gnyen rnams la chos drug dang*/ phyag chen sku gsum ngo sprod/ drung rang gi bka' 'bum sogs dbang lung mang po gnang*/ rab sgang stod smad du phebs/ sgo gnyis pa'i lha khang du pad+ma ḍā ki gnyis zhal gzigs/ gser she thang du mkha' spyod ma dmar mo gzigs/ rta ra dgon du dbon rin po che grags pa dpal dang rma se dgon du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnod sbyin chen po zhing skyong dang bcas pa zhal gzigs/ sgo sdong gi 'khrug mo che sdum/ mi ma yin gyi cho 'phrul thams cad gzhil bar mdzad/ stod smad kyi 'khrug mang thams cad zhi bar mdzad nas dza lan+dha rar phebs/ gser gyi bka' 'gyur glegs shing thags bcas bzhengs/ 'gom bde chen dgon du rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor mang po zhal phyes/ chu dkon sar bden tshig brjod pas chu mig rdol/ spo 'bor sgang dang*/ phyag 'bu khe gsum gyi skye 'gro nams la chos 'khor bskor/ spam phug tu phebs/ rdo rje bdag med ma rigs drug zhal gzigs te sgrub thabs badzad/ gzhan yang lhag pa'i lha mang po zhal gzigs nas sgrub thabs mang po mdzad/ de nas gling dpon chen sogs kyis gdan drangs te tre yul stod smad/ shes khog lcags mo la sogs rnams su+u phebs nas lha sde mi sde rnams chos dang zang zing gis tshims par mdzad/

khang dmar dgon du bstan 'gyur bzhengs pa'i cha rkyen sbyar/ gling dpon seṅge rgyal mtshan gyis 'dan gzhung du spyan drangs nas de phyogs thams cad chos dang zang zing gis tshims par mdzad/ karmar phebs/ lha khang gi zhig gso dang 'dus sde dar rgyas mdzad/ de nas rtogs ldan chos dpal ye shes la sogs pa rnams kyis gdan drangs nas kong po phyogs su phebs/ lam bar gyi mi dang mi min thams cad smin grol la bkod/ rnam thos kyi ri bor phebs/ dam pa sangs rgyas/ klu sgrub yab sras/ slob dpon pad+ma/ mi la ras pa/ dpal mgon phyag drug pa sogs bla ma yi dam chos skyong grangs las 'das pa zhal gzigs/ gzhan dag gi skye ba snga phyi mang po gsungs/ de la sogs pa snod ldan gyi slob ma mang po smin grol la bkod par mdzad de/ dgung lo so bdun pa chu sprel lo la rtse lha sgang du bzhugs tshe lkog 'gyur gyi ltas shes rnams kyis sku keg shin tu rtsub zer bar slob dpon sangs rgyas seṅges brtan bzhugs phul pa na/ da la nged la skyon mi yong zla ba dgu nged rang gis khag theg pa yin gsungs/ de nas gsa' phur phebs nas rten thams cad la na bza' dang mchod pa phul/ so so'i rten sgam du bzhag nas phyag dam gyis mnan/ dbu zhwa dang bsre 'pho'i zhal gdams kyi phyag dpe sogs go shrī rin po cher gtad de lung bstan bka' rgya can mdzad/ nged ma sleb bar rten 'di rnams rgya ma nyams par gyis/ sham+bha la pa dang ma kha pa rtsod par yod pas rigs ldan gyi grogs la 'gro dgos par yod gsungs/ brtan bzhugs kyi gsol ba btab kyang ma gnang*/ mgur du ma mdzad cing khyad par ka bzhi seng chen ma byang nas dbu tshugs gsungs te yang yang bzhengs/ sa yang yang g.yo ba dang nyi zla la 'od med pa dang*/ 'dab chags thams cad so so'i sde tshan du 'dus nas/ mi bzod ba'i ca co byed cing 'phur lding byed/ sngar bka' lung gnang ba'i zla ba dgu song ba'i bya lo gsar tshes kyi tshes brgyad kyi snga dror da ni kho bo yang bka' brgyud gong ma'i gral du sdod pa yin pas/

sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i rin po che// thugs rje'i bdag nyid mthong ba don ldan la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// zhes gsol ba thob cig gsungs te/ mya ngan las 'da' bar bstan/ sku gdung zhugs su bzhus pas 'ja' dang me tog gi char babs dbu bum ril/ thugs ljags spyan gsum ring bsrel chu shel gyi mdog can dung dkar g.yas 'khyil gyi rnam pa can du ma dang*/ ring bsrel kha dog lnga ldan brgya phrag du ma sogs byon no// rje de la slob ma'i tshogs bzang la grangs mang ba rnams byon pa'i gtso bo ni/ go shri dpal 'byor don grub dang*/ kun mkhyen 'jam dpal bzang po/ kun mkhyen rong ston/ stag lung zhabs drung la sogs pa rnams so//
